Author: Jackie
Name: Line Me Up
Punchline: Walk onto your target's spot and match the way they're facing.
Description: Walks your character onto the spot a target is standing on, then turns you to face the same way they do. Movement is real: your character walks there under its own power, easing off speed on the final approach so it settles on the mark rather than overshooting it. Supports a target-relative offset, a facing offset, and a continuous follow mode that keeps you on their mark as they move. Built for lining up at close quarters - there is no pathfinding.
